sentences.text:
However, the said report was not accepted and directions were issued to the police to conduct further investigation.
5.
Petitioner filed protest petition before the Court which came to be dismissed and against the said order petitioner filed revision but the revision was also dismissed by the Sessions Court.

Thereafter,
the petitioner against the said order filed a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. which is stated to be pending before this Court.
6. The learned counsel further submits that during the pendency of the investigation, the petitioner had voluntarily surrendered his passport before the Investigating Officer.
The passport was later released to the petitioner vide order dated 07th June, 2022.
He further submits that before surrendering the passport, petitioner had been travelling frequently to Bangkok and Canada without any restrictions.

7. It is further submitted that the learned Trial Court vide order dated 07th June, 2022 while releasing the passport placed a condition that petitioner shall not fly out of India without permission of the ld.
Trial Court, where after petitioner filed an application for permission to travel abroad on 06th September, 2022.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The application was allowed subject to stringent conditions including surrender of title documents of his office at Dwarka.
9. The application filed for modification of the conditions came to be dismissed vide order dated 05th December, 2024.

10. According to learned counsel, the petitioner has duly co-operated in the investigation of the case and never tried to misuse the liberty, despite the fact that till date he is neither an accused nor arrested in the present case.
11. Issue notice.
Notice is accepted by learned APP appearing for the State.
12. Let notice be also issued to respondent no. 2, subject to petitioner taking requisite steps returnable on 28th August, 2025.
Notice be given dasti.
13. Meanwhile in terms of the request made, petitioner would be at liberty to approach the ld. Trial Court for grant of permission to travel abroad.
